title: metamusic loop metrics row
description: One row of metrics/loop.jsonl. Never holds command lines, paths, titles or tokens.

wait_ms.description: Time spent waiting for a heavy-run slot; wall_ms excludes it (a run refused or timed out by the lock exits 75 with wait_ms set). Absent on older rows.

load1_start.description: 1-minute load average when the run started (after any lock wait). Absent on older rows or hosts without /proc/loadavg.

failing_names.description: Names of up to 5 failing leaf tests (Go --- FAIL, bun (fail), Playwright [project]: title). Reduced to a safe character set; never holds paths, URLs or output text. Absent on older rows.

retry_passes.description: Tests that failed and then passed on retry (Playwright flaky count). 0 when nothing retried. Absent on older rows.
